record.original_question: Determine all cubic graphs that are topological-minimal obstructions to embedding in the torus.

evidence.quote: Problem 3.3 Find the cubic topological-minimal non-toroidal graphs.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A graph is called toroidal if it admits an embedding into the torus (the closed orientable surface of genus one). A graph G is a topological-minimal obstruction to embedding in the torus (a topological torus obstruction) if G is not toroidal but every proper topological minor of G is toroidal; equivalently, G is non-toroidal but every graph obtained from G by deleting an edge, deleting a vertex, or suppressing a degree-two vertex is toroidal. A graph is cubic if every vertex has degree exactly 3.

Determine (classify completely) all cubic graphs that are topological-minimal obstructions to embedding in the torus.
artifact.status_search_result: A computer-assisted search by Chambers identified 206 cubic topological torus obstructions and this list is conjectured to be complete, but a theoretical proof of completeness is not established. Recent work (e.g., classifications of cubic torus obstructions with small Betti number, and of cubic projective-plane obstructions and their toroidal embeddings) makes partial progress, so the problem appears partially solved rather than fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: A large set of torus obstructions and how they were discovered (Myrvold & Woodcock)
status_evidence.snippet: At least 250,815 topological torus obstructions are known; Chambers found 206 cubic topological torus obstructions believed (but not proven) to be complete.
status_evidence.claim: Cubic case has 206 known obstructions, completeness conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Cubic torus obstructions of small Betti number
status_evidence.snippet: Classification of cubic torus obstructions with Betti number at most eight.
status_evidence.claim: Partial theoretical classification for low Betti number.

status_evidence.title: Toroidal embeddings of cubic projective plane obstructions
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cubic projective-plane obstructions and their behavior with respect to torus embeddings.
status_evidence.claim: Recent related work addresses cubic obstructions.
